title: Count cached prompt tokens in the Anthropic input token count

files.patch:
@@ -171,9 +171,12 @@ def stream_handler(&chunk_handler)
 
       handle_tool_use_streaming(intermediate_response)
 
-      if (input_tokens = intermediate_response.dig("message", "usage", "input_tokens"))
+      if (usage = intermediate_response.dig("message", "usage")) && usage["input_tokens"]
         # https://docs.anthropic.com/en/api/messages-streaming
-        @message.input_token_count = input_tokens
+        # input_tokens only counts what comes after the last cache breakpoint, and we cache the
+        # instructions and the conversation prefix, so add the cache writes and reads to get the prompt size
+        @message.input_token_count = usage["input_tokens"] +
+          usage["cache_creation_input_tokens"].to_i + usage["cache_read_input_tokens"].to_i
       end
       if (output_tokens = intermediate_response.dig("usage", "output_tokens"))
         @message.output_token_count = output_tokens # no += because an early token count is partial, but the final one is the total

@@ -191,6 +191,27 @@ class AIBackend::AnthropicTest < ActiveSupport::TestCase
     assert_equal [], result
   end
 
+  test "stream_handler counts cached prompt tokens in the input token count" do
+    @anthropic.instance_variable_set(:@stream_response_text, "")
+    @anthropic.instance_variable_set(:@stream_response_tool_calls, {})
+    message = @anthropic.instance_variable_get(:@message)
+
+    handler = @anthropic.send(:stream_handler) { |chunk| }
+    handler.call({
+      "type" => "message_start",
+      "message" => { "usage" => {
+        "input_tokens" => 12,
+        "cache_creation_input_tokens" => 300,
+        "cache_read_input_tokens" => 4000,
+        "output_tokens" => 1
+      } }
+    }, 0)
+    handler.call({ "type" => "message_delta", "usage" => { "output_tokens" => 25 } }, 0)
+
+    assert_equal 4312, message.input_token_count
+    assert_equal 25, message.output_token_count
+  end
+
   test "handle_tool_use_streaming initializes tool call on content_block_start" do
     @anthropic.instance_variable_set(:@stream_response_tool_calls, {})
